svg.text: Pollen sampler Proto HAT: where each part goes
Top view, 40-pin header at the top. Every dot is a hole (2.54 mm apart). Steps: docs/hat.md
upper area: free for later parts
J4 motor pins: a 4-pin header in the #18, #27, #22 and #23 holes
strips 6, 7, 8 row 1, tab to the top
Solder in this order: low parts first, Q1 last.
red wire on +, black wire on − (top pin)
NeoPixel string: DIN top, 5V middle, GND bottom
driver board IN1, IN2, IN3, IN4
camera ribbon goes through the slot
• Each lower strip is 5 holes joined from top to bottom.
• Strips are not joined to each other or to the rails.
• Holes in the same rail are all joined.
• Q1: printed side faces you when you look from the rails.
• Legs then go G, D, S from left to right.
• Upper rails (+3V3, GND) and upper strips are not used yet.
